History:
 hidden deep in the tropical islands of Hawaii, there lies a secret village of cheerful people living their life in peaceful bliss. The Village People know no struggle or strife, where everything seems to be handed to them on a platter free of charge. This easygoing life does have a cause behind it all, hung up inside the village chiefs hut lies an ancient tiki mask carved by the villages original founding chief.
 The founding chief carved the mask as a good omen for his village, the wish worked and the village was protected from outside issues and conflicts
 upon the chiefs final moments of life, he prayed to the gods that his village would continue to be protected under the mask for generations to come. Once again his wish worked and the mask would become the sign of good omen a
